text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert - high packet loss and 5xx spike seen from multiple regions (us-east-1, eu-west-1). Paging on-call for egress issues with upstream transit.

alex_cheng: ack. seeing 5xx spike + TCP retransmits from app logs. correlation with egress to TransitQ for a subset of prefixes (198.51.100.0/24).

maria_neteng: ran traceroutes from sfo-edge -> 198.51.100.12, seeing ICMP Fragmentation messages and sudden !F marks on hop 4.

jordan_ops: users reporting timeouts and failed asset uploads. P99 latency up, retries causing cascades.

samira_khan: joining bridge https://zoom.bridge/incident2041122334. created incident channel #inc-2041122334.

oncall-bot: Paging: @alex_cheng - please acknowledge the incident.

alex_cheng: ack. collecting tcpdump and traceroute outputs, uploading to incident folder.

alex_cheng: ```
traceroute -n 198.51.100.12
1 10.0.0.1 0.8 ms
2 203.0.113.9 12.2 ms
3 198.51.100.1 98.7 ms !F
4 198.51.100.248 102.1 ms !F
```

maria_neteng: tcpdump shows repeated "ICMP type 3 code 4 (Fragmentation needed)" from TransitQ side. looks like DF/PMTU mismatch or middlebox dropping fragments.

jordan_ops: customer impact: payments APIs and file uploads failing intermittently. CS tracking ~12 customers with increased 5xx in last 12m.

alex_cheng: quick mitigation: applying MSS clamp on egress toward TransitQ for affected prefixes to avoid fragmentation. config snippet below.

alex_cheng: ```
interface eth1
  ip tcp adjust-mss 1300
route 198.51.100.0/24 next-hop 10.1.1.1
```

maria_neteng: opened ticket with TransitQ (TKT-7890) and attached traceroutes + pcaps. asked for MTU posture and any recent middlebox changes. ETA 15m.

samira_khan: @customer_support please notify the top impacted customers, provide retry workaround and temporary smaller payload guidance.

customer_support: notified top 5 customers, provided steps and a CI workaround. collecting any customer-specific traces.

alex_cheng: as a second mitigation i pushed a prefer-route to CarrierZ for 198.51.100.0/24 (static next-hop), shifting ~40% of egress traffic off TransitQ. packet loss dropped on those flows.

jordan_ops: after route change nginx 502 rate down from ~8% -> ~2%. still watching overall errors and TLS failures.

maria_neteng: TransitQ acknowledged receipt, investigating possible MR changes on their edge that set DF incorrectly or blocked ICMP frag-needed replies.

samira_khan: created follow-up tasks: add synthetic ICMP frag-needed detection to e2e monitors, validate DF handling in our egress path, add runbook entry for MSS clamping.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigations applied and monitoring. If metrics stable for 2h, incident will be moved to monitoring. Handoff: @jordan_ops takes night watch at 03:00 UTC.

jordan_ops: ack handoff. will escalate to NOC and pursue BGP-level fixes or provider hotfix if TransitQ doesn't restore proper MTU handling.

maria_neteng: leaving ticket open with TransitQ for root cause. we'll remove the static prefer-route after validation. closing slack thread once metrics confirmed stable.

samira_khan: summary for postmortem: upstream provider MTU/fragmentation handling caused selective packet loss and application 5xx. Mitigations: MSS clamp + route shift to alt provider + customer workarounds. Owner: maria_neteng. ETA for postmortem draft: 48h.

alex_cheng: uploading final pcaps and timeline into incident folder. marking incident as resolved->monitoring. :white_check_mark:
